tasks.title: Scope and benchmark
deliverables: Agree a written capability matrix: supported user roles, providers, markets, channels, volumes and explicit exclusions.
Define a 100-contact synthetic benchmark and measurable gates for duplicate handling, filter correctness, workflow timing and cost.
Expose explicit capability states: preview, unavailable, configured, degraded, live. Preserve localhost-only defaults.

acceptance.criterion: Reject unsupported capability execution before any external request.
Verify prototype fixtures cannot enter production outreach.

tasks.title: Shared-service foundation
deliverables: Add workspace, user, membership, credential-reference, job, job-attempt and audit-event models with reversible deployment migration plan.
Server-enforce tenant scoping and rep/manager/admin permissions; retain separately tested local single-user mode.
Encrypt provider tokens through a managed secret boundary; rotate and revoke without logging secrets.
Implement durable jobs with leases, idempotency keys, retry budgets, backoff, dead-letter inspection and restart recovery.

acceptance.criterion: Cross-tenant IDs and rep attempts to change credentials return denied.
Kill a worker between provider acknowledgment and local commit; replay must not duplicate the side effect.
Test expired credentials, revocation, recovery and secrets redaction.

external_dependencies: Chosen provider contracts, sandbox credentials, or deployment decisions as applicable; never invent them.

tasks.title: Licensed data and enrichment
deliverables: Implement a provider-neutral search/enrich/verify interface with deterministic fake adapter and one chosen licensed provider.
Store field-level provenance, provider record IDs, collection/verification timestamps, confidence and allowed uses.
Implement canonical identity resolution, duplicate merge preview, refresh jobs and suppression propagation.
Reserve credits before requests, enforce per-job cap, settle actual spend, and stop waterfall at the configured quality threshold.

acceptance.criterion: Overlapping provider records merge without losing source attribution.
429, timeout, invalid fields and exhausted credits produce explicit retriable or terminal states.
No verified label without verification evidence; stale records remain visibly stale.
Contract tests pass with fake adapter; live sandbox evidence is separately recorded.

external_dependencies: Chosen provider contracts, sandbox credentials, or deployment decisions as applicable; never invent them.

tasks.title: Multi-channel sequence engine
deliverables: Persist draft/revision/enrollment/step-run models; adapt existing campaigns without duplicating send logic.
Support email, call task and manual social task with delays, timezone windows, pause/resume and per-revision approval.
Implement edit invalidation, sender limits, reply/bounce/opt-out cancellation and retry-safe dispatch through existing gate.

acceptance.criterion: DST change and weekend delays produce correct next-run times.
Suppression or reply arriving immediately before dispatch prevents send.
Restart after dispatch cannot duplicate mail; edits invalidate prior approval.
Builder preview matches stored canonical sequence and handles invalid or empty steps.

external_dependencies: Chosen provider contracts, sandbox credentials, or deployment decisions as applicable; never invent them.

tasks.title: Telephony and call workspace
deliverables: Add telephony adapter, short-lived client sessions, call attempts, dispositions and signed event ingestion.
Start with single-line calling; add concurrent dialing only after provider policy, abandonment behavior and user controls are specified.
Define recording consent policy, access, retention, deletion and transcript permissions before enabling recording.

acceptance.criterion: Duplicate/out-of-order callbacks converge on one correct call state.
Invalid webhook signatures, unauthorized calls and blocked numbers are denied.
Call cancel, no answer, disconnected agent and provider outage are exercised.
Sandbox call and transcript tests are separately marked from mocked tests.

external_dependencies: Chosen provider contracts, sandbox credentials, or deployment decisions as applicable; never invent them.

tasks.title: CRM sync
deliverables: Implement one selected CRM OAuth adapter first, with minimum scopes and tenant-bound refresh tokens.
Persist connection, external record map, field mapping, sync cursor, conflict and sync run.
Support preview diffs, per-field source of truth, tombstones, conflict review and incremental bidirectional sync.

acceptance.criterion: Duplicate webhook and retry do not create duplicate contacts.
Remote deletion is not silently resurrected; merge and null-clearing semantics are tested.
Revoked token stops sync without losing cursor.
Rate limits and partial batch failure resume correctly.

external_dependencies: Chosen provider contracts, sandbox credentials, or deployment decisions as applicable; never invent them.

tasks.title: Inbound capture and assignment

Persist assignment rules, owner capacity and routing decisions; preview rules before activation.
Specify round-robin fairness, fallback ownership and notifications; approval still applies to outreach.

acceptance.criterion: Malformed and spam submissions never enter outreach.
Concurrent submissions preserve assignment fairness and deduplicate by ingestion key.
Rule changes retain the historical explanation for existing assignments.

tasks.title: Meetings scheduler

Use timezone-aware timestamps and atomic conflict-safe reservations with compensating provider cancellation.
Implement round-robin availability and revocation handling.

acceptance.criterion: Two simultaneous requests for one slot produce at most one confirmed booking.
DST, differing attendee timezones, cancellation, provider timeout and retry are covered.
Disconnected calendar never exposes stale availability as bookable.

Define complaint/bounce denominators and windows; reconcile events with actual send IDs.
Expose operational runbooks; mailbox/domain procurement and any warming adapter remain disabled until separately configured and validated.

acceptance.criterion: Hard bounce and complaint events cancel future sends and update suppression.
Mailbox pause takes effect before queued dispatch, including races.
Missing events are unknown health, not a fabricated green status.
Per-mailbox and workspace budgets remain atomic under concurrent workers.

acceptance.criterion: Fixture events with duplicates, late arrivals and cancelled meetings yield exact expected totals.

UI labels and downloaded reports use the same metric definitions.

acceptance.criterion: Untrusted page content cannot issue privileged commands or capture extra tabs.

Reuse existing drafting/approval pipeline; writes require actor, tenant, approved plan and current revision.
